sections.heading: Premium Computation
sections.body: Section A - Own Damage: Basic OD premium on IDV, add-on for IMT 23 (lamps, tyres, tubes), less No Claim Bonus at 20%. Section B - Liability: Basic Third Party premium as notified by IRDAI, Legal Liability to paid driver and cleaner (IMT 39), Compulsory PA cover for Owner-Driver. Net premium and GST are shown in the schedule table above.

sections.heading: Limitations as to Use
sections.body: The policy covers use only under a public carrier permit for the carriage of goods within the permitted area. The vehicle may carry chemicals classified as hazardous under the Central Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989 only where the driver holds a valid hazardous goods endorsement and the vehicle displays the prescribed Class labels and emergency information panel. The policy does not cover use for organised racing, pace making, reliability trials, or carriage of passengers for hire or reward.

sections.heading: Driver Clause
sections.body: Any person driving the vehicle must hold an effective driving licence at the time of the accident, with the relevant transport endorsement, and must not be disqualified from holding or obtaining such a licence. Endorsements IMT 21, IMT 23 and IMT 39 are attached and form part of this policy.

sections.heading: Important Notice and Grievance Redressal
sections.body: Stamp duty has been paid by consolidated method vide order of the Government of Maharashtra. In case of any grievance, contact the Grievance Officer, Sahyadri General Insurance Company Limited, at grievance@sahyadrigeneral.example.in or toll-free 1800-209-4417. If not resolved within 15 days, you may approach the Insurance Ombudsman, Mumbai, or the IRDAI Bima Bharosa portal. Please refer to the policy wording for full terms, conditions and exclusions.
